bridge-type.label: Tesla Fleet Bridge
bridge-type.description: Handles authentication and connectivity to Tesla Fleet API

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Application Client ID
parameter.description: This is the Client ID provided by Tesla when you add a new Application for openHAB to your Tesla Account.

parameter.name: clientSecret
parameter.label: Application Client Secret
parameter.description: This is the Client Secret provided by Tesla when you add a new Application for openHAB to your Tesla Account.

parameter.name: pollingIntervalSeconds
parameter.label: Connect Refresh Period (seconds)
parameter.description: This is the frequency of the polling requests to the Tesla Fleet API.

thing-type.label: Tesla Vehicle
thing-type.description: A Tesla vehicle connected via Tesla Fleet API
